prompt_md: A bag holds 2 black and 2 white pawns. Without looking, you take out two. What's the chance they're the same color?
prompt_short: 2 black, 2 white pawns. Draw two. Same color?
hint_md: After the first pawn, what's left in the bag?
explain_intuition_md: Same color or not sounds like a coin flip. But once you've taken the first pawn, only one of the three left in the bag matches it.
